tripsPage.title: Trips
tripsPage.subtitle: Vehicles and drivers on the road: stops, proof of delivery and e-way bills · tracking only during a trip
tripsPage.noRight: Trips need logistics rights. Ask Admin.
tripsPage.emptyBody: Make a trip from the scheduled deliveries on the dispatch board.
tripsPage.noStops: No deliveries on this trip yet.
tripsPage.startHelp: The driver usually starts the trip from the phone. Starting here takes the stock out now; the database first checks every delivery's posted invoice, e-way bill, credit and stock.
tripsPage.closeHelp: Close once every stop has its proof of delivery or a failed-delivery reason.
tripsPage.lastSeen: Last recorded {{time}} · {{date}} · driver's phone · not live
tripsPage.positionNote: Location is recorded only during an active trip, after the driver accepts the notice, and is kept 90 days.
tripsPage.ewayNote: Every delivery needs its e-way bill number before the vehicle leaves unless Admin sets a value threshold.
tripsPage.failHelp: Everything for this stop goes back to the dispatch place in quarantine and the order quantity opens again.
tripsPage.placeNotKept: No place kept (outside the driver's trip window or older than 90 days).
tripsPage.newHelp: Choose a vehicle (expired papers block it unless Admin overrides) or name a hired transporter, the driver and the deliveries.
tripsPage.noDrivers: No one has the driver role
tripsPage.deliveries: Scheduled deliveries not on a trip
tripsPage.noFree: No scheduled deliveries are free. Schedule one on the dispatch board.
